name: ID Holdings Corporation
summary: ID Holdings Corporation provides information technology (IT) services in Japan. The company operates through system management, application development, IT infrastructure, cyber security, consulting and education, and other businesses. It offers IT system operation and management; system planning, design and development, operation and maintenance, and project management support services; and IT platform design and construction.
